study type: Educational Intervention Program Description and Initial Evaluation
outcome: Improvement in skills and knowledge of anaesthesia providers
Effective translation of skills and knowledge to the workplace
cohort: Anaesthesia providers in low- and middle-income countries.
finding: Initial follow-up suggests that the SAFE-OB course leads to improvement in skills and knowledge among anaesthesia providers, which translates effectively to the workplace, making it an effective method for improving obstetric anaesthesia care.
